title: AskRequest
description: An open-ended question for the assistant. This is the tier most requests do not take — the trace screen answers the common ones deterministically, and this is the escape hatch for what it cannot (docs/06).

timezone.description: IANA name. Never a fixed offset.

question.description: What the person asked, in their own words and language.

history.description: The last few exchanges, oldest first, so a follow-up has something to refer to. Two at most: "neden?" needs one, and more turns the escape hatch into a chat app, which ADR-0014 decided against.

language.description: Which language to answer in. The app sends what the person chose in settings; omitted, the server infers it from the question, which it used to do always and which drifted — the model was asked to match the question's language and nothing checked that it had.
